title: PF-10 Contractual Personnel Request Form (DocuSign)
content: DocuSign form used exclusively for revisions and continuation requests for existing grant-funded contractual personnel at Morgan State University. New employees must NOT be onboarded via PF-10; instead, use the EPAF system via WebSIS. Submitted to the MSU ORA signing group through DocuSign. Questions about these DocuSign request forms go to Rebecca Steiner in the Office of Research Administration, rebecca.steiner@morgan.edu or 443-885-4044.
